Exchanges.Text:
Good morning, Gate team-c.

Our sprint goal is: Customers can pay by card and failed payments retry automatically. There are 5 days left in the sprint.
Daniel, please share your update: what did you finish, what are you working on next, and is anything blocking you? Keep it brief so we can keep moving.
Yesterday I finished card tokenisation and shipped the payment status API version two. Today I'm adding idempotency keys to payment requests. Nothing blocking me.

Daniel, I’ve noted your commitment: yesterday you finished card tokenisation and shipped the payment status API version two, today you’re adding idempotency keys to payment requests, and nothing is blocking you.

Task 19, Prepare reconciliation report for audit, is past its due date. What is the new date?
The reconciliation report is at risk. I'll start it right after the idempotency keys, and flag it if it slips.

Daniel, I’ve noted your commitment: the reconciliation report is at risk, you’ll start it right after the idempotency keys, and you’ll flag it if it slips.

story 3, Customer payment plan summary page, has been Active for 5 days. Still on track?
Yes, it's on track. I'll pick the summary page back up as soon as the idempotency keys are in.
Who can help unblock the summary page work that’s waiting on the idempotency keys?
Yes, that's right. That's everything from me.

Thanks, Daniel.

Maya, what did you finish, what’s next, and is anything blocking you?

Yesterday I reviewed the settlement schema. Today I'm continuing the settlement file validation. I'm blocked on bug 12. The sandbox gateway keeps timing out, and I need access to the platform team's staging gateway.
Sorry to jump in, Maya, but we hit the same gateway timeouts last sprint when we upgraded the TLS library, and it took us days to track down.
Right, I think the root cause was the connection pool settings, so we should compare the gateway configuration between sandbox and staging, and also check whether the sandbox certificate was rotated.
Let's take that offline, I will add it to the parking lot, and Maya, please carry on.
That's everything from me.
Maya, who can help unblock bug 12 by getting you access to the platform team’s staging gateway?
Daniel can help. He fixed the same gateway timeouts last sprint, so I'll pair with him on the staging access today.

Maya, I’ve noted your commitment: Pair with him on the staging access today.

Maya, story 5, Update PCI scan exceptions, has been Active for 5 days. Still on track?
The PCI scan exceptions are waiting on the security review. I'll chase them today.
Maya, I’ve noted the blocker and your commitment, and it will be flagged for follow-up.

Thank you, Maya.

Admin, what did you finish, what’s next, and is anything blocking you?
Yesterday I finished the refund API tests.
Today I'm still working on the payment retry story.
No blockers.
Admin, task 14, Write retry load test, is past its due date. What is the new date?
It slipped because the sandbox was down.
I should finish it tomorrow.
Admin, who can help unblock this sandbox outage that’s delaying task 14?
Maya can help.
She's already chasing the platform team about the sandbox, so I'll sync with her after the stand-up.
Admin, I’ve noted the blocker: Waiting on the sandbox from the platform team, and it will be flagged for follow-up.
Yes, that's right.
That's everything from me.

Blockers were raised and captured: the summary page work is on track and will resume after idempotency keys are added, Maya is blocked on bug 12 due to sandbox gateway timeouts and needs staging gateway access, the PCI scan exceptions are waiting on security review, and there were sandbox availability issues. We also parked a side discussion about gateway timeouts for offline follow-up between Daniel Park and Admin. Nobody was absent and nobody failed to respond. task 15 is stale and wasn’t covered, and its owners will get a follow-up; follow-ups, including any for absences or non-responses if they occur, are coming in Teams. Thank you, everyone.
